Task: Open the existing settlement as author, GM and player
Success condition: Immediate useful map; permitted tools and current context are clear
Evidence to record: First-useful-view time, help, wrong-mode actions, visible content

Task: Repair crossing roads, enter an interior, publish a prepared revision
Success condition: Geometry stays editable; joins and dependent overlay changes are predictable
Evidence to record: Before/after native diff, reference resolution, author observation

Task: Select a door among overlapping art and search for its action
Success condition: Inspector identifies correct object, layer and source; no guesswork
Evidence to record: Selection errors, completion time, keyboard/pointer paths

Task: Join as each player and inspect delivered data
Success condition: Neither receives hidden triggers, GM labels, other private sheets or restricted dependencies
Evidence to record: Actual client payload/state inspection with known secret fixtures

Task: Attempt owned, unowned and replayed token/action changes
Success condition: Authorized action commits once; unauthorized or duplicate request has no extra effect
Evidence to record: Request ID, subject, owner receipt, revision and state delta

Task: Open/close a door and change light/fog/sight
Success condition: Art, blockers, exploration and per-character visibility remain coherent and private
Evidence to record: Both clients' state and rendered result; no secret labels/count leaks

Task: Disconnect a player mid-request and reconnect
Success condition: Clear connection state; accepted state restored without phantom success or duplicate action
Evidence to record: Connection timeline, server revision, client reconciliation

Task: Restart after a scene checkpoint and unsaved local edits
Success condition: Restored scope and data loss, if any, are explicit; no cross-campaign overwrite
Evidence to record: Save/checkpoint provenance and recovered state comparison

Task: Edit map revision while an action or floor transition is pending
Success condition: Stale references are rejected or explicitly reconciled by the owner
Evidence to record: Controlled interleaving, rejection explanation, final accepted state

Task: Type in a dialog, undo text, press Escape and change tools
Success condition: Only intended focused context responds; no underlying map or live action fires
Evidence to record: Event trace and native/live before-after state

Task: Undo a map edit, cancel preparation and correct an accepted game action
Success condition: Each uses the appropriate history/owner path; no silent campaign rollback
Evidence to record: Separate author history and gameplay event/compensation evidence

Task: Traverse a linked floor, ship hatch or portal
Success condition: Correct authorized destination, scale, owned actor and visibility load; retry safe
Evidence to record: Scene IDs/revisions, transition receipt, both clients' views

Task: Open a scene with missing, outdated or unavailable pack/extension
Success condition: Understandable status and placeholder; original placements preserved
Evidence to record: Dependency manifest, blocked action, successful later resolution

Task: Load art-heavy fixtures on the lower-powered target
Success condition: Remains usable under a measured agreed budget; loading/cancel paths work

Task: Import exported UVTT in named receiving versions
Success condition: Calibration, doors, blockers and light policy match intended output; private content excluded
Evidence to record: Recipient screenshots, measured distances, structured import result

Task: Run a long session across maps and presentation modes
Success condition: Stable responsiveness and connection; understandable recovery after induced failure
Evidence to record: Session duration, retained resources, errors, outcome and device specs
